summary.text: Steve Kesselring is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 18 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Kesselring's career experience includes owning a small business and working in ecommerce consulting.
He won the general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 18 on November 5, 2024.
